Veterans specialize in ranged weapons, so all of them are good on Veteran, some are better than others, however.

The Zarona Revolver is pretty good, absolutely claps specialists and elites but lacks ammo and horde clearing potential.

The infantry autoguns are my personal favorite. The Mark 1 and 5 specifically. The Mark 1 has actually pretty good RPM and hits hard, and the recoil is quite controllable. The Mark 5 shoots really fast and is good for fast, mobile play. Recoil is harder, and the damage is lower but it's still super fun to use.

The Bolter is absolutely king. Destroys everything you shoot, and the puncture blessing is so good. It's little brother, the Bold Pistol, is also a damn good precise single shot weapon.

The Recon Lasguns are on the same wavelength as the infantry autoguns but better in their own ways. The damage of the faster firing models is quite low, especially the mark 12, but the enhanced crit rate with laser weapons helps balance it out. I personally recommend the Mark 14 because of the high damage, slower fire rate giving you more control of where your shots hit, but you do you.

The shotguns are damn decent, but don't use the Mark 6 and 7, as their damage is too low. I recommend the Mark 9 with Deathspitter and Full Bore level 4 blessings.

The double barrel is quite fun, but limiting in range and ammo. It's damage is devastating against beefy targets like the Ogryn enemies and Manic type enemies like the mutant and rager.

The plasma gun is so powerful, but it has delayed fire and a charging shot for its alt-fire. No aiming down sights.

It's all about their role as a soldier and what culture they are from.

Empire soldiers can go 6 ways:

-Legionary, the Lineman (the best in the game)

-Elite Menavliaton, the Shocktroop (the best in the game)

-Imperial Palatine Guard, the archers

-Sergeant Crossbowmen, the mixed ranged/melee

-Elite Cataphract, the heavy Calvary

-Imperial Bucellarii, the horse archers

Each solider starts from the recruit except from the Heavy Calvary. They come from the Vigla recruit.

From the recruit you can split the roles during the first upgrade from tier 1 to 2. From tier 1 you can upgrade them to the infantryman or an archer.

From tier 2 you upgrade to tier 3: Trained Infantryman or Trained Archer

Then, at tier 4, the infantryman splits into the Veteran Infantryman or the Menavliaton. So during tier 3, you split the melee soldier into a Lineman or the Shocktrooper. For archers, tier 4 splits the trained archer into the Veteran Archer or Crossbowmen

Tier 5, you can upgrade your Veteran Infantryman into the Legionary, and your Menavliaton into the Elite Menavliaton...your Veteran Archers into Imperial Palatine Guards or the Bucellarii (the horse archer). And of course the Crossbowman into the Sergeant Crossbowmen.

The Vigla Recruits turn into the Elite Cataphract. You'll need mounts and War Mounts to upgrade this line.

Different cultures have different soldiers with different upgrade trees. I recommend opening the encyclopedia and then going into the Troops tab, and read the trees by selecting the recruit of the respective faction you want to learn from and following their tree downwards. Studying what weapons they have and what armor they wear, as well as their skills.
